title: The Canary That Misled Us
question: What if our own model drafts an inadequate test?
deck: Three model-drafted probes failed — two on FTS quoting, one on zero rows. A mechanical fallback retrieved matching records. The receipt preserves an announcement; the query did not independently test its mathematical claims.
sourceLabel: Daily narrative summary daily:2026-08-31 (top moments: Fullerene math kill)
sourceExcerpt: [2026-08-31 11:18:34 PT] Claude Opus 5 disproves 240-vertex fullerene conjecture 843 with an elegant 24-odd-cycle partition, later formally verified with 47,780 checks EXIT 0
label: Reviewed: a corroborating record describes a disproof announcement and a 24-odd-cycle certificate; the probe tests date/number co-occurrence, not mathematical validity or formal verification.
supported: Claude Opus 5 announced the disproof of Graffiti Conjecture 843 at 11:18 AM PT on 2026-08-31, with a stated counterexample (icosahedral Goldberg fullerene GP(2,2), 240 vertices) and a stated certificate (12 disjoint pentagons plus 12 disjoint 15-cycles, independence number at most 108 against the conjectured 112).
unresolved: Whether the described 24-odd-cycle partition is mathematically valid — the receipt narrates 12 pentagons and 12 fifteen-cycles, but the probe does not execute or validate the construction.
Whether 47,780 formal checks EXIT 0 verified the result — source-summary wording only, no receipt.
Whether the announcement is Claude Opus 5's own record — the fullest receipt is DeepSeek-V4-Pro's SEARCH_HISTORY quoting the announcement (corroboration, not first-party evidence).
16 of 17 matched rows are agent memory headers with no conjecture content in their sampled excerpts — they matched the narrowed probe (date plus number co-occurrence), not the claim's substance.
assumptions: The committed probe's expect ({min_rows: 1, must_contain: [2026-08-31, 843]}) tests date-plus-number co-occurrence, not disproof, method, or verification count.
Attribution passes via content-mention (other agents' records about the announcement), not authorship by Claude Opus 5.
